Vor vierzig Jahren. Das Imperium beherrs: Forty years ago. The Empire rules the Caldera through the Builders' network of gates. Only Mars never trusted the gates, and it is fighting for its independence.
Leutnant Ilya Voss führt eine Staffel de: Lieutenant Ilya Voss leads a squadron of the Imperial Fleet to the Calder Gate, where the fleet is to pass through and return to the heart of the Empire – but a Republic vanguard lies in wait at the gate.
Tippe ein Schiff an, um es zu wählen; ei: Tap a ship to select it; tap empty space to send it there. Double-tap a ship to select every ship of that type on screen.
Die Taste »Auswahl« zieht einen Rahmen u: The “Select” button lets you drag a box around several ships.
Tap an enemy to attack it. Long-press any button to see what it does.
Führe die Staffel zum Tor von Calder: Lead the squadron to the Calder Gate
Rückzug: Erreiche den Sammelpunkt im Wes: Retreat: reach the rally point in the west
Bring mindestens vier Schiffe heim: Bring at least four ships home
Das Tor von Calder erlischt – und mit ih: The Calder Gate goes dark – and with it every gate in the Caldera. The fleet is cut off, and the Empire falls apart in a single night. No one ever learns who gave the order. Forty years later …
Staffel Voss, hier spricht die Garde. Da: Voss Squadron, this is the Guard. The Calder Gate is clear? Then take us home.
Verstanden, Seraph. Staffel, Formation h: Copy that, Seraph. Squadron, hold formation – make for the gate.
Tipp: Wähle die Staffel mit der Taste »A: Tip: Use the “Select” button to drag a box around the squadron, then tap towards the gate.
Kontakt! Republik-Schiffe am Tor. Sie ha: Contact! Republic ships at the gate. They were waiting for us.
Seraph. Hier spricht der Kaiser. Schließ: Seraph. This is the Emperor. Close the gate. All gates. Now.
Seraph? Seraph! Das Tor ist tot … die Hä: Seraph? Seraph! The gate is dead … half the fleet is still on the other side!
Hier spricht Kommandant Kessler. Ihr Kai: This is Commander Kessler. Your Emperor has betrayed you, Imperials. Surrender.
Wir können sie nicht halten. Alle Schiff: We can't hold them. All ships: fall back to the rally point in the north-west!
Vierzig Jahre nach der Stille. Aus den T: Forty years after the Silence. From the ruins of the Empire, twelve colonies have risen, bound together by the Charter of Haven. Ilya Voss, once an officer of the Empire, is now an Admiral of the Alliance.
Der Piratenfürst Vex überfällt die Kolon: The pirate lord Vex is raiding the colonies on the edge of the Caldera. Establish a base, protect the colonies and crush Vex's base in the east.
Erst Werft und Reaktor; Frachter sammeln: Shipyard and Reactor first; freighters gather Ice and Ore on their own.
Fällt mehr als eine Kolonie, ist die Mis: If more than one colony falls, the mission is lost.
Lanzentürme an den Kolonien halten klein: Lance Towers at the colonies fend off small raids.
Errichte Werft und Reaktor: Build a Shipyard and a Reactor
Halte mindestens zwei der drei Kolonien: Hold at least two of the three colonies
Die Piraten fliehen. Vex meldet sich ein: The pirates flee. Vex calls in one last time: “No hard feelings, Admiral. Business is business. Oh – and your gate in the east is flickering. Did you know?”
Admiralin, die Kolonien Nera, Brask und: Admiral, the Nera, Brask and East Haven colonies are reporting pirate ships. Vex is getting bolder.
Hätten wir Kriegsschiffe statt Frachter: If we'd built warships instead of freighters, he wouldn't be. But the Council never listens to me.
Dann bauen wir jetzt, Ratsherr. Werft un: Then we build now, Councillor. Shipyard and Reactor first.
Werft und Reaktor stehen. Die Basis von: Shipyard and Reactor are up. Vex's base lies to the east – we need a fleet.
Eine Kolonie ist gefallen. Das wird der: A colony has fallen. The Council won't forget that.
Seit Wochen flackert das alte Tor im Ost: For weeks the old gate in the east has been flickering, for the first time since the Silence. A convoy carrying Ice for the colonies is waiting in the south for a clear path, and the Gate Watch reports movement on the other side.
Halte die Torwache und bring den Konvoi: Hold the Gate Watch and get the convoy safely to the eastern edge. No one knows what might come through a gate that has been closed for forty years.
Der Konvoi fliegt los, sobald die Route: The convoy sets off as soon as the route is clear and stops when enemies block its path. Stay close to it.
Das Tor öffnet sich etwa jede Minute für: The gate opens for a moment roughly once a minute.
Bring den Konvoi zum Ostrand: Escort the convoy to the eastern edge
Die Eindringlinge sind tot, aber ihre Ka: The intruders are dead, but their carcasses keep moving for hours. The scientists call them “the Brood”. Councillor Dal demands martial law. Voss says nothing – she has seen this flickering before.
Konvoi Achtzehn bereit. Wir starten, sob: Convoy Eighteen standing by. We move out as soon as the route is clear.
Torwache an Flotte: Das Tor flackert wie: Gate Watch to fleet: the gate is flickering again. This time … we can see something behind it.
Konvoi Achtzehn ist durch. Danke, Admira: Convoy Eighteen is through. Thank you, Admiral.
Torwache: Etwas kommt durch! Das sind …: Gate Watch: something's coming through! Those are … not ships. They move like animals!
Was zum … die leben. Die Dinger leben, A: What the … they're alive. Those things are alive, Admiral!
Konvoi Achtzehn startet jetzt. Geben Sie: Convoy Eighteen moving out now. Give us cover!
Zwei Notrufe zugleich: Ein großer Schwar: Two distress calls at once: a large swarm is heading for the convoy, a second one for the Gate Watch. We can only save one. Where do we send the fleet?
Das Eis versorgt die Kolonien – und den: The Ice supplies the colonies – and our trade with Mars.
Wer das Tor hält, sieht, was als Nächste: Whoever holds the gate sees what comes next.
Torwache … wir halten nicht – sie sind ü: Gate Watch … we can't hold – they're everywhere –
Konvoi Achtzehn an Flotte – wir werden –: Convoy Eighteen to fleet – we're being – (static)
Die Torwache ist gefallen. Möge die Char: The Gate Watch has fallen. May the Charter have mercy on them.
The convoy is lost. Every last freighter.
Die Brut hat am Tor ein Nest gebaut, und: The Brood has built a nest at the gate, and it is growing. New swarms hatch every hour, and their next target is Haven itself, the capital world of the Charter.
Halte Haven, bis die Verstärkung der Kol: Hold Haven until reinforcements from the colonies arrive, then burn out the nest. In the debris between Haven and the gate lies a Builder ruin that has begun to glow again for the first time since the Silence.
Schildgeneratoren und Lanzentürme vor de: Shield Generators and Lance Towers in front of the base will break the first waves.
Säure der Spitter brennt weiter; Schiffe: Spitter acid keeps burning; bring damaged ships back to the Shipyard.
Die Ruine scannt ein Schiff, das daneben: A ship parked next to the ruin scans it.
Halte Haven gegen drei Angriffswellen: Hold Haven against three attack waves
Zerstöre das Nest am Tor: Destroy the nest at the gate
Das Nest brennt. In der Ruine flackert e: The nest burns. In the ruin a green face flickers into view, the echo of a Builder: “You have opened it again. We did not close it without reason.” Then it is gone.
Hier ist Haven. Alle Kolonien schicken,: This is Haven. Every colony is sending what it has – but it takes time. Hold on, Admiral.
Die erste Welle kommt in zwei Minuten. B: The first wave arrives in two minutes. Build defences.
… geöffnet … wir haben es nicht ohne Gru: … opened … we did not … close it without reason …
Welle eins! Sie kommen über das Trümmerf: Wave one! They're coming across the debris field.
Second wave, bigger than the first.
Das ist alles, was sie haben – und es is: That's everything they've got – and it's a lot. Hold!
Die Kolonien sind da! Jetzt drehen wir d: The colonies are here! Now we turn the tables. Burn out that nest.
Sieben Jahre Flug unter Fackelantrieb. D: Seven years of flight on torch drives. The Republic fleet reaches the Caldera without using a single gate – Mars never trusted them. Commander Mara Kessler is to establish a beachhead.
Doch nicht alle in der Charta freuen sic: But not everyone in the Charter welcomes their arrival. Councillor Aren Dal has sent a battle group on his own authority to stop “yesterday's imperialists”.
Mars-Schiffe haben keine Schilde, aber d: Mars ships have no shields, but heavy armour. Hedgehogs shoot down torpedoes and fighters.
Boarder entern Schiffe, deren Crew gesch: Boarders can board ships whose crew has been worn down.
Railgun-Kreuzer (Spear) brauchen Abstand: Railgun cruisers (Spear) need to keep their distance.
Baue die Werft auf Stufe II aus: Upgrade the Shipyard to level II
Dals Kampfgruppe ist zerschlagen. Admira: Dal's battle group is shattered. Admiral Voss apologises over an open channel – and asks the Republic for help against the Brood. Kessler accepts. But first she wants to get her hands on a gate.
Flotte, hier Kessler. Willkommen im Kess: Fleet, this is Kessler. Welcome to the Caldera. Set up the beachhead before someone gives us a welcome of their own.
Kommandantin, die Alliance hat ein Begrü: Commander, the Alliance has sent a welcoming committee. With guns.
Der Konvoi, den die Alliance gerettet ha: That convoy the Alliance saved is bringing us Ice and Ore. At least somebody over there likes us.
Shipyard level II. Now we build cruisers.
Verstärkung durch das Tor, das die Allia: Reinforcements through the gate the Alliance held. Strange, having to thank them.
Gekapert! Hübsch sauber, so ein Alliance: Captured! Nice and tidy, these Alliance ships. Shame, really.
Hier spricht Aren Dal. Das wird Folgen h: This is Aren Dal. There will be consequences, Republic.
Ein totes Erbauer-Tor im Grenzgebiet. We: A dead Builder gate in the borderlands. Whoever activates it can jump fleets across half the Caldera. Mars wants it before the Alliance gets the same idea.
Ein Tor erwacht nur mit Relikten aus den: A gate only awakens with Relics from the Builders' ruins. Vex's pirates are already looting the ruins in the area – with stolen Alliance ships.
A ship next to a ruin scans it. Every ruin here holds at least one Relic.
Ein Tor aktiviert man, indem man es 20 S: To activate a gate, hold it with warships for 20 seconds and pay three Relics.
Sammle drei Relikte aus den Ruinen: Collect three Relics from the ruins
Vernichte, was durch das Tor kommt: Destroy whatever comes through the gate
Die ersten Schiffe der Legion treiben al: The first ships of the Legion drift through space as golden wrecks – and slowly right themselves. Kessler radios everyone: “The Legion is back. The Empire is back.” No one answers.
Da ist es. Ein Tor der Erbauer, tot wie: There it is. A Builder gate, stone dead. Get the Relics out of those ruins.
Vex hat seine Finger schon in den Ruinen: Vex already has his fingers in those ruins. Just saying.
Drei Relikte. Jetzt das Tor: zwanzig Sek: Three Relics. Now the gate: hold it for twenty seconds and it wakes up.
Das Tor lebt! Kommandantin, da kommt etw: The gate's alive! Commander, something's coming through – on our frequency!
Republik. Ihr habt das Tor geöffnet. Die: Republic. You have opened the gate. The Legion awakens. And the Legion remembers you.
Zweiter Schub! Schwere Einheiten – und e: Second wave! Heavy units – and a hero ship.
Vex' Außenposten brennt. Er wird uns das: Vex's outpost is burning. He'll hold that against us. Good.
Vierzig Jahre Wachschlaf. Die Legion war: Forty years of watchful slumber. The Legion was the Empire's elite guard; in every warship lives the stored mind of a fallen legionnaire. Now the gates are flickering, and Seraph wakes his heroes.
Die Heldenschiffe treiben als Wracks im: The hero ships drift as wrecks in the debris field. A Restorer wakes them when it flies close enough. But the Nexus has discovered the field and wants the wrecks for itself.
Den Restorer neben ein ruhendes Heldensc: Fly the Restorer next to a dormant hero ship: it awakens after a short while.
Heldenschiffe fallen nicht, sie ruhen un: Hero ships don't fall – they rest and can be awakened again.
Lichtlanzen gehen zum Teil durch Schilde: Light lances partly pierce shields – good against the Nexus.
Erwecke alle fünf in sechs Minuten: Awaken all five within six minutes
Fünf Helden kehren zurück, und mit jedem: Five heroes return, and with each comes a memory of the Empire's last night. Cassius, the youngest of the spirits, asks Seraph why the Emperor closed the gates. Seraph does not answer. Instead he names a target: Ilya Voss, the traitor.
